data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'khoros', meaning 'dweller', and 'i', meaning 'golden haired'. Corri was a name given to girls with golden hair in ancient Greece. The name Corri carries the meaning “Fine golden haired one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Corri usually hope their child will grow to embody fine golden haired one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
